subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123, Departure: 10th August 2022 at 9:00 AM, Arrival: 10th August 2022 at 12:00 PM. We hope you have a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you on board. Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us. Best regards, The Airlines Team
